name: Block Hardcoded URLs
description: Warns if edited files contain hardcoded URLs that are not localhost
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Warn about hardcoded URLs in edited files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  URLS=$(grep -oE 'https?://[a-zA-Z0-9./?=_-]+' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'localhost' | grep -v '127.0.0.1' | grep -v 'example.com')
  if [ -n "$URLS" ]; then
    COUNT=$(echo "$URLS" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
    echo "WARNING: $FILE contains $COUNT hardcoded URL(s). Consider using environment variables:"
    echo "$URLS" | head -5
  fi
fi
exit 0
